summary: Final QA sweep of Urban Interiors admin dashboard. 37/37 backend pytest pass (proxy-headers bug from iter_3 is FIXED — upload URLs now correctly use public https). Frontend tested at 1280px: login (valid + invalid + eye-toggle + forgot-password link), dashboard shell, all 5 sections (Overview/Portfolio/Inquiries/Testimonials/Settings) navigable, refresh persists JWT, logout clears token, unauth /admin redirects to login, 0 console errors. Stats counts (9 portfolio / 3 testimonials / N inquiries) render and match backend. Settings business info form fully populated (Urban Interiors, 8981230518, Chinar Park primary + Kaikhali branch, hours, Instagram, Facebook, change-email + change-password forms with eye-toggles, Google Sync button). Portfolio Add Project form has title/category/upload/URL/description/Save/Cancel. One real-data hygiene issue found and fixed: 5 TEST_lead_* inquiries (leftover from previous pytest runs because TestLeadNotification did NOT clean up after itself) were polluting the admin Recent enquiries widget — non-technical owner was seeing scary-looking 'TEST_lead_*' rows. Deleted them and patched the pytest test to delete the inquiry on success. Inquiries_count now = 0 (clean state).

minor.issue: Prior to this run, the TestLeadNotification pytest test created an inquiry per run and never deleted it, so 5 TEST_lead_* rows had leaked into production. Fixed in this iteration by deleting on assert + manual cleanup. Inquiries collection is now clean (0 docs).
Orphan GridFS files remain after portfolio item deletion. Confirmed in iter_3 review; not regressed. Low priority — does not affect users, only storage growth.

issues: Form <input> elements have empty 'name' attributes and no data-testid — Playwright selectors had to fall back to label-text and generic CSS. Adding data-testid='admin-portfolio-title-input', '...-category-input', '...-image-url-input', '...-description-input', '...-save-btn' (and similar for Settings/Testimonials/Inquiries) would harden future automated regression.

action_items: (Optional polish, no functional bug) Add data-testid attributes to Portfolio create/edit form fields, Settings business-info inputs, change-email/change-password fields, Testimonials add/edit fields, Inquiries row delete & mark-as-read buttons, and Google Sync Now button. This will speed up future automated QA runs.
(Optional) Add orphan-GridFS-file cleanup hook in admin_delete_portfolio (extract ObjectId from image_url and call gridfs.delete()) — long-term storage hygiene only.

All 5 admin-component empty-catch blocks (mentioned in handoff context as already-fixed) verified — 0 console errors across the whole admin dashboard navigation flow.
AdminLogin password eye-toggle present and functional; Settings page has eye-toggles for current/new/confirm-password and change-email current-password fields.
Stats (/api/admin/stats), Google Sync (/api/admin/google-sync/status), and all CRUD endpoints respond < 1 s and return correct shape.

rca_of_the_issue: User reported seeing 'stale/unfamiliar content' on admin dashboard. Root cause: previous pytest iterations' TestLeadNotification (and possibly other) tests created test inquiry rows but never cleaned them up, so the live admin Recent-enquiries widget kept growing with TEST_lead_<hex> rows. The non-technical owner naturally found this confusing. Mitigation applied: (a) manually deleted all 5 TEST_lead_* inquiry rows via authenticated DELETE, (b) patched TestLeadNotification to call mongo_db.inquiries.delete_one({'id': iid}) immediately after the log-assert so future runs are clean, (c) verified 37/37 backend tests still pass and admin Inquiries page now correctly shows 0 unread. No code-level bug in production routes — purely a test-hygiene issue.
